Name: The Little Girl Who Lost Her Sight
Narrative: Fatima lost most of her vision after a severe infection went untreated due to lack of funds. A specialist has confirmed her sight can be restored with corrective surgery but the family cannot afford the cost.
Needs Items: Corrective eye surgery | Post-operative medication | Follow-up consultations

Name: A Father Fighting to Walk Again
Narrative: Omar was the sole provider for his family of six before a work accident left him with a fractured spine. Without surgery he will never walk again and his family will be left without income.
Needs Items: Spinal surgery | Physiotherapy sessions (6 months) | Home support aid

Name: Family of Eight — No Food for Three Days
Narrative: A widow with seven children reached out after her husband passed suddenly. With no income and no savings the family has gone days without a proper meal.
Needs Items: Monthly food basket | Household essentials | Children's nutritional supplements

Name: Village Without Clean Water
Narrative: An entire village of 300+ residents relies on a contaminated river for drinking water. Waterborne illness is common especially among children under five.
Needs Items: Borehole well drilling | Water pump installation | Sanitation education session

Name: Young Student — No Books No Future
Narrative: Ahmed lost his father at age nine. His mother cannot afford school fees or supplies. He is bright and determined but risks dropping out entirely without sponsorship.
Needs Items: Annual school fees | Uniform and shoes | Textbooks and stationery

Name: Displaced Family Seeking Shelter
Narrative: A family of five was forced to flee their home due to conflict. They are currently living in a temporary shelter with no furniture no warm clothing and limited food.
Needs Items: One-time emergency relief payment | Blankets and winter clothing | Kitchen supplies
